market_stallholder.text: Welcome to the English Market. It has stood here since 1788, so we have sold fish to the Georgians, the Victorians and everyone since.
It was run by Cork's Protestant corporation, and the name stuck. Everyone in here is as Cork as can be.
In 2011 Queen Elizabeth II dropped in and laughed so hard at a fishmonger's joke that it made the papers.

then.text: Another loaf? You will have fairies following you home. Off you go.

else.text: Take a soda bread for the road. We cut a cross in the top, to let the fairies out.
